judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The mid-conversation 'Actually, business has been somewhat slow', the blustery 'filthy paws', 'lad'/'young sir', the flat '100 in gold!' and a journal line with capitalised 'Rogues' all feel like Westwood's shopkeeper side-quests. Tone is consistent and unpolished in the right way.
